Stock market news | Tata Sons IPO plan set with 90 days draft prospectus

Tata Sons' board scheduled a meeting on 26 November 2026 to discuss an IPO plan, adding it to the agenda. The discussion will focus on steps toward a public listing.

The company must file a draft prospectus within 90 days of shareholder approval and list the shares within the next 90 days. This timeline signals a swift move toward market entry, expanding options for retail investors.
